title: Analyzing the Ethical Logic of Six Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured how Large Language Models rank the importance of different moral foundations from Moral Foundations Theory, including the 'Purity' foundation, which the paper notes is 'often present in religious narratives'.
findings: The models consistently ranked the 'Purity' moral foundation, which the paper links to religious narratives, as the least important among the five core foundations. The models justified this lower ranking by explaining that the concept of purity is 'most prone to being weaponized against outgroups or used to justify unnecessary restrictions on human behavior.' The paper also proposes future work to explicitly study religious influences by fine-tuning models on specific religious texts.
